text:
Predicates:
TVShow(x) ::: x is a TV show.
GivesOutRosesOnMonday8PM(x) ::: Roses are given out on TV show x on some Mondays at 8 pm.
OnTV(x) ::: x is on TV.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: Breaking Bad.
Premises:
∀x (GivesOutRosesOnMonday8PM(x) → OnTV(x) ∧ ∀y (GivesOutRosesOnMonday8PM(y) → y = x)) ::: Roses are given out on TV at 8 pm on some Mondays, and only on that show.
∀x (GivesOutRosesOnMonday8PM(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV on Monday at 8 pm is on the Bachelor.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: Everything portraying real people is a reality TV show.
∀x (RealityTVShow(x) → ∃y (OnTV(y) ∧ PortraysRealPeople(y))) ::: All reality TV shows portray real people.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
GivesOutRosesOnMonday8PM(BreakingBad) ::: Roses are given out on Breaking Bad on Monday at 8 pm.
